macro.m_description: Bank app (HBL, AL Habib, Alfa, JazzCash, easypaisa) khule = saari Accessibility + Developer options + USB debugging OFF (pehle ki haalat yaad). Bank app se hate / screen band 30 sec = sab wapas pehle jaisa. Phone restart par bhi wapas. Wapas lagate waqt MacroDroid ki dono services HAMESHA ON (yaad khali ho tab bhi).

m_actionList.m_messageText: 🏦 Bank mode — Accessibility + Developer options OFF
✅ Bank band — Accessibility + Developer options wapas ON
✅ Bank mode reh gaya tha — sab wapas ON

aiFeedback: WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS (ADB hack) zaroori; Usage Access bhi.
